t: Revolutionizing Software Deployment: How Nix Flakes Simplify Development Beyond Docker and pip
s: This article explains how to integrate Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) into an application by indexing user actions and uploaded files (CSVs, text). It details setting up a vector store, indexing data, retrieving context for LLM prompts, and handling long contexts, aiming to improve search and LLM query responses.
sub: Indexing User Actions and File Content
